description.value:
The cellular walls that make up your hardened exterior have adapted to protect you from a multitude of threats. Choose one of the following energy damage types: acid, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the damage type you chose.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
